handle: The port route is matching decompilation.
body: Chosen 2026-09-04, superseding the wasm-unit pipeline. Candidate C is compiled and diffed against retail bytes until byte-identical.

handle: Do not relaunch the wasm-unit driver.
body: `finish-port --drive` is obsolete on this route and must not be relaunched. Its queue, compile-fix loop and assembly gate are retired with it.

handle: Match, synthetic test and playable parity are separate claims.
body: A recorded match, a passing synthetic test and a playable-parity result must never be reported as one another.
118 of the 405 matched functions are a single `blr`. True about the bytes, thin about the program.
mwcc-rs compiles only 10.07 % of the game's instructions; 87.2 % is compiler-blocked.

handle: Only committed or re-derivable numbers are evidence.
body: Every number is read from a committed artifact or re-derived by a named script. A machine-local number says so and is not treated as evidence.

handle: The wasm-unit queue numbers cannot be reproduced.
body: They come from a machine-local, untracked state file and are not reproducible from a clone. Flagged by the verifier: not evidence.

handle: A match resting on a masked data relocation is unverified.
body: Such verdicts are recorded `MATCH_UNVERIFIED` and are never written to `src-match/`.

handle: List the top 20 unmatched shape-shared classes and pick the next batch.
body: Use the matching loop's `shapes` command. No model step is needed for this class.
